instruction: Please help me enable the built-in video editor in VS Code to edit the video file in Downloads.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code is a code editor and does not include a built-in video editor. While VS Code can be extended with various features, video editing is completely outside its scope as a text/code editor.
